buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of

Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting: Attendance at the pre-bid meeting and site inspection is compulsory for all bidders. Bidders must attend the meeting at the date, time and location specified in the GeM bid. 1. Site Inspection / Pre-Bid Meeting Bidders are advised to inspect the proposed installation location and verify the site opening, existing supp orts, access and operating clearance. The meeting/site visit shall be conducted as stated in the GeM bid, w ith date, time, venue and contact details communicated through the permitted official process. 2. Discussion of Technical Details Site-specific details such as iron bar/angle sizes and thicknesses, ACP sheet thickness, LED specifications a nd placement, logo design/content/size/placement, colour and finishing shall be discussed during the site v isit/pre-bid meeting. These details shall not be assumed by bidders where they have not been specified. 3. Official Clarification of Requirements Any technical detail or clarification agreed for the bid shall be communicated to all prospective bidders thr ough the official GeM clarification/corrigendum process, as applicable. No bidder shall receive an undisclos ed advantage through private clarification. 4. Dimensions The required overall gate dimensions are 22 feet in width and 12 feet in height. Bidders shall verify the sit e opening and support conditions before fabrication and raise any discrepancy through the official clarifica tion process. 5. Materials and Workmanship The gate shall use new and unused iron/MS bars, iron/MS angles, ACP sheets, LED lights and logos as desc ribed in the technical specifications and as clarified through the official GeM process. Fabrication and insta llation shall be carried out neatly by competent personnel. 6. Scope and Price The quoted price shall include fabrication, materials, transportation, installation, fittings, ACP panels, LED c omponents and logos as confirmed, surface preparation, protective coating, labour, testing and finishing n ecessary for a complete functional gate. 7. Safety and Site Cleanliness The successful bidder shall follow safe working practices, protect the surrounding area and existing propert y, ensure safe electrical installation, and remove waste and debris after completion. 8. Inspection and Acceptance The completed gate shall be checked for dimensions, stability, alignment, welding, finish, hinges, locking, ACP panels, logo fixing and LED operation. Defects attributable to materials or workmanship shall be rectifi ed before acceptance, subject to the contract terms. 9. Completion Period

The work shall be completed within the delivery/completion period stated in the GeM bid or purchase orde r. Any defect rectification shall be handled in accordance with the contract and applicable GeM terms. .
